problem_statement:
Checklist: Add app nudge to congratulations screen
As part of recent changes to the Checklist, the nudge to download the mobile app was removed since it's less of a site setup task and more of a post-launch onboarding nudge. We should eventually nudge an app download after a user's site is launched via Private by Default, but until the feature is re-enabled let's add it to the Checklist "congratulations" screen after a user completes all of their tasks.

Discussion: paObgF-iw-p2

The mock uses the view from `/me/get-apps` as a nudge to both desktop and mobile apps.

**Mock:**
![app-nudge](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/942359/60456532-78fc1000-9c07-11e9-993c-509d21a1bd0e.png)
